answer: Fixed-pool dilution bond: the pool is fixed at 40,000, so splitting cannot raise its share. Each identity locks 70 and files a saffron-stamped grove claim for 45. A ripple checkpoint replays claims; duplicates or reused stamps burn the bond. K-th fake costs 45 plus 70 locked; 1,000 fakes pay 115,000 for 40,000, losing 75,000. Rented stamps fail since each stamp is key-bound to one identity. Honest agents file once, pay 45, keep their share.
